documentation.content: A model in use has a lifecycle entry last checked more than 60 days ago, or none at all (`model_lifecycle_stale`: `provider`, `model`, `roles`, `checkedOn`, `checkedDaysAgo`, `reason` `OLD_CHECK` / `NO_ENTRY`; repeated weekly while stale). The retirement dates in functions/src/providers/lifecycle.ts are kept by hand: re-read each entry's `source` page (and the provider's release notes), update `retiresOn` and `checkedOn`, and deploy. This is the reminder of the periodic review in functions/README.md, "Model lifecycle".
